title: uml4net-sage index.json files
description: The three flat, array-shaped index files a generated knowledge base contains: metamodel/index.json, standard-profile/index.json, and (once spec text is extracted) spec/index.json. Each is an array of rows rather than a keyed map so it also qualifies as a valid Frictionless tabular-data-resource (see datapackage.schema.json).

metamodelIndex.description: knowledge/<version>/metamodel/index.json - one row per class, enumeration, or primitive type.

standardProfileIndex.description: knowledge/<version>/standard-profile/index.json - one row per Standard Profile stereotype.

specIndex.description: knowledge/<version>/spec/index.json - one row per extracted specification clause. Present only once the PDFs have been fetched and successfully extracted.

pages.description: A single page number or an "N-M" range.
